sources.title: NMDA receptor-dependent long-term potentiation and long-term depression (LTP/LTD)
sources.journal: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Biology
sources.notes: Comprehensive authoritative review covering LTP/LTD mechanisms to 2012; key for establishing postsynaptic locus of LTP expression

sources.title: Structure, function, and allosteric modulation of NMDA receptors
sources.authors: Hansen KB, Yi F, Perszyk RE, Furukawa H, Wollmuth LP, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya A, Bhattacharya S, Traynelis SF
sources.notes: Authoritative structural/functional review; key for subunit composition, Mg2+ block mechanism details, GluN2 kinetic diversity

sources.title: The AMPA Receptor Code of Synaptic Plasticity
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of AMPA receptor roles in plasticity; critical for understanding GluA1 vs GluA2/3 differential rules

sources.title: AMPA receptor trafficking and LTP: Carboxy-termini, amino-termini and TARPs
sources.notes: Recent review focusing on molecular mechanisms of AMPA receptor synaptic targeting; TARP-PSD95 slot model

sources.title: Synaptic memory requires CaMKII
sources.authors: Tao W, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya A
sources.notes: Key experimental paper; shows CaMKII required not just for LTP induction but also maintenance; complete LTP reversal by CaMKII inhibition post-induction

sources.title: Theta-burst LTP
sources.notes: Review of theta-burst LTP; connects LTP to natural hippocampal theta oscillations and in vivo conditions

sources.title: Neuromodulated Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity, and Theory of Three-Factor Learning Rules
sources.notes: Theoretical review; key for connecting Hebbian LTP to reinforcement learning via neuromodulators; used for AI comparison section

sources.title: Long-lasting potentiation of synaptic transmission in the dentate area of the anaesthetized rabbit following stimulation of the perforant path
sources.notes: Historical foundational paper; first description of LTP; abstract only - full text not available openly

sources.title: Excitatory amino acids in synaptic transmission in the Schaffer collateral-commissural pathway of the rat hippocampus
sources.authors: Collingridge GL, Kehl SJ, McLennan H
sources.notes: Historical foundational paper; first showed NMDA receptor blockade (AP5) abolishes LTP; abstract only - full text not available openly
